narrNote: The District does NOT appear on NARR's official affiliate list and has no NARR state affiliate. DBH instead funds and oversees recovery residences directly (e.g., DBH Recovery Residence NOFA DCRR102822, posted on dbh.dc.gov).
notes: The District has no counties; DBH is simultaneously the state and local behavioral-health authority, so countyDirectory is not applicable. The Access HelpLine (1-888-7WE-HELP) is DBH's 24/7 entry point, featured on the verified DBH homepage; the agency phone is from the same page's footer. Medicaid SUD/IMD coverage runs through DHCF's Whole-Person Care Transformation 1115 demonstration — the verified DHCF 1115 page reports CMS approved a five-year renewal on Sept 23, 2026, effective Oct 1, 2026 through Sept 30, 2031. BACKFILL 2026-10-22: peerOrgs now lists the Consumer Action Network (CAN), the consumer-run DC advocacy organization named on DBH's own Consumer Advocacy and Peer Support page as a peer-operated partner; can-dc.org was fetched and content-verified on 2026-10-22. Other DBH-listed partners were not added: the Consumer Leadership Forum's site (clfofdc.org) was unreachable, WRAP of DC's site renders as an unfinished template, and DBH lists only the national nami.org for NAMI DC — none met the verified-official-site standard in this pass.
